title: Dental PPO Plans Binder Premium and Activation of Coverage
content:
**Activation.** An applied enrollment under the Dental PPO Plans becomes active on its coverage effective date once the binder (first month's) premium has been received on the funding billing account. When the binder arrives after the effective date but within the binder deadline, coverage is activated retroactively to the coverage effective date.

**Cancellation for an unpaid binder (time condition).** An applied enrollment may be cancelled for an unpaid binder only after the binder deadline has passed following the coverage effective date of the enrollment.
- The clock starts from the coverage effective date shown on the enrollment record.
- The binder deadline is the coverage effective date plus the plan's binder deadline days, counted in calendar days.
- Cancellation is allowed only on a day strictly after that date; on the deadline date itself it is not yet allowed.

**Effect of cancellation.** A cancelled enrollment never had coverage: its termination date is set to the day before the coverage effective date, its termination reason is that the binder was not paid, and any claim with a date of service on or after the effective date is denied as not eligible.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, 30-day deadline, coverage effective 1 March)
| Day of the cancellation check | Binder still unpaid | Cancellation allowed? |
|---|---|---|
| 31 March (the deadline date) | Yes | No |
| 1 April (the day after) | Yes | Yes |
